items.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021
items.q: I played with Olatunji for four years in the band too you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, with his teaching. You could go play with other people, we all did that you know. But when he had his then he’d play that. But he never said a thing about not playing with somebody else. We used to play with somebody else. I played with Olatunji for four years in the band too you know. Yeah we was playing that high life music and stuff.
This may be a very obvious question but what was the mood of the band when Sun Ra passed?
